result.description:
An exceptional opportunity has emerged for a General Practitioner, holding either General or Specialist Registration, to join a vibrant medical practice in the heart of Wollongong. Situated along the picturesque coastline of New South Wales and approximately 92 km from the Sydney CBD, this clinic offers a professional environment where clinical excellence meets a thriving seaside city lifestyle. The practice is led by experienced GPs who foster a culture of mentorship and support, allowing incoming practitioners to focus entirely on delivering high-quality patient care. 

 The clinical environment is characterized by a young, energetic team of health professionals supported by seasoned medical leadership at the management level. This synergy between fresh perspectives and veteran experience creates a unique space for holistic growth. Practitioners work within a modern facility featuring nine consulting rooms and a fully equipped, modernized treatment room. The practice utilizes Best Practice software to ensure efficient workflows and is supported by an experienced nursing and administrative team. To further enhance patient care, the facility includes dedicated Chronic Disease Management support, onsite pathology, and integrated mental health services. 

 Operating primarily as a bulk billing clinic, the practice provides a competitive remuneration package of 65% to 75% of billings alongside a minimum income guarantee to ensure a smooth transition. The incoming GP will enjoy full clinical autonomy to practice medicine their way, with the added benefit of pursuing special interest areas within the clinic’s diverse patient base. Recognizing the importance of work-life balance, the practice offers significant flexible working arrangements, including options for remote access. For those looking to contribute to the future of the profession, there are also opportunities for CPD support and to step into supervisor roles. 

 Located in a DPA/MM1 region, this role is suitable for both permanent placements and long-term locums. Beyond the clinic walls, Wollongong offers an enviable lifestyle, boasting world-class beaches like Wollongong City Beach and North Wollongong Beach. The city is a hub of education and healthcare, being home to the University of Wollongong and the nearby Wollongong Hospital. With excellent public transport, a diverse cultural scene, and a wealth of local shops and cafes within walking distance, it is the perfect destination for a practitioner seeking professional financial success in a vibrant, community-spirited coastal city.   Apply Now
